 The presidents of China, Russia and the United States – Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump – have begun their unprecedented meeting in the Chinese city of Shenzhen .
 Trump described the meeting as essential, criticising his predecessors for declining conversations with rivals.
